news_items.headline: Cummins (CMI) Raises 2026 Outlook as Power Systems Hits Record on Data Center Demand
news_items.summary: Cummins reported Q1 2026 revenue of $8.4B (+3% YoY) and beat on adjusted EPS, driven by record Power Systems quarter on data-center backup-power demand. Management raised full-year 2026 guidance (revenue 8-11%, adj EPS $6.15) and returned $519M to shareholders.

news_items.headline: Did Softer EPS, Higher Sales and Insider Selling Just Shift Cummins' (CMI) Investment Narrative?
news_items.summary: Article flags softer EPS trajectory, higher sales offset, and recent insider selling at Cummins as factors that may be shifting the investment narrative.

news_items.headline: Cummins Stock: Earnings Beat On The Way (NYSE:CMI)
news_items.summary: Pre-earnings analysis predicting beat for Cummins, citing strong Power Systems segment and data-center demand backdrop ahead of Q1 2026 print.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Truist Securities maintained Buy and raised price target to $730 from $703 on 2026-04-20. Aggregator splits show 48 Buy / 29 Hold / 0 Sell; 3-month avg PT around $616.73 with high $730 (Truist).

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 already reported (early May) with beat on adjusted EPS and raised FY guidance. Near-term catalyst: May 21 Analyst Day in NYC expected to detail next Power Systems capacity tranche. Street expects continued data-center backup-power demand and EPA 2027 low-NOx pricing tailwind ($10K-$15K per-truck price increase) to support earnings.
